conversation.q: Walk me through a normal week. What do you do, and when?
conversation.a: Ami mainly corporate clients handle kori, around 14 ta account. Every week client der sathe relationship calls thake, mostly Sunday ar Monday, eta office theke kori. Protiti Tuesday sondha 6 ta theke 7:30 porjonto credit pre-meeting hoy, oikhane ami amar clients er loan proposals present kori.

conversation.q: Anything monthly, or that needs travel?
conversation.a: Mashe ekbar Chattogram jai, oikhane amar tin ta client er factory visit korte hoy, usually two days lage. Ar mash sheshe ekta portfolio report CFO office e pathai, eta ghore bose o kora jay.

conversation.q: Anything coming up during your leave?
conversation.a: Haan, clients C, D ar E er trade finance renewals April er 10 tarikh er moddhe due. Oder statements gula shudhu amar email e ache. Rafiq bhai cover korbe bole plan, kintu uni ei client der sathe kokhono kaj koren ni.

job_description: Manage a portfolio of corporate clients and weekly relationship calls
Prepare and present loan proposals at the weekly credit pre-meeting
Visit client sites outside Dhaka as needed
Submit the monthly portfolio report to the CFO office
Complete the quarter-end loan classification review for her portfolio
Process trade finance renewals for assigned clients

answers.quarter_end_review: Yes, it often runs until 9 pm on the last two days of the quarter.
